name: G30 racing starfighter
description: The G30 racing starfighter was a type of racing ship manufactured by Incom-Freitek. The starfighter's S-foils could be adjusted for better aim of the wingtip-mounted Taim & Bak KX10B laser cannons or to accommodate the need for speed or maneuverability. The Green Ace flown by racer Hype Fazon was a modified G30.
